description: The Civil Protection Directorate (MINAT) coordinates relief, rescue, logistics and auxiliary forces
procedure: Crisis committees at departmental, regional and national level

description: The National Council for Civil Protection proposes preventive measures, coordinates their implementation and becomes a crisis unit during a declared calamity (Decree 96/054)
procedure: Converts into a crisis unit once a calamity is declared

description: The warning must be disseminated after the activation of emergency plans (Decree 98/031)
Emergency and rescue plans are organised by Decree 98/031
procedure: Set by Decree 98/031 (to verify in the official text)

description: Administrative authorities order the evacuation of danger zones
The national meteorology service issues weather forecasts and warnings
assumed_by: ALERTE team, 2026-10-07: organisation decree of the meteorology service to obtain

description: The National Risk Observatory collects and disseminates information on risks (Order 037/PM)
Licensed operators run the networks and can technically send SMS to subscribers
ANTIC is the national body in charge of electronic security; spoofing and fraudulent links are cybercrimes (Law 2010/012)
Local councils take part in local civil protection and receive community reports
assumed_by: ALERTE team, 2026-10-07: to verify in Law 2019/024

description: The State must detect, assess, notify and report outbreaks (International Health Regulations)
The data protection authority enforces Law 2024/017 with powers of investigation, audit and coercion
Controllers, including operators, must secure personal data and respect consent
Transfers of personal data abroad require the prior authorisation of the data protection authority
depends_on: APDP able to grant authorisations quickly in a crisis
